title: Laamb
summary: A wrestling sport of Senegal and the Gambia, held on a circle of sand with drummers and a loud crowd behind each champion. Two wrestlers wrap, lift, hook and drive until one is put down or driven out of the circle.
howToPlay: Read the rival's stance: it shows the move he is about to make.
Tap the answering move while the marker is in the bright zone.
Wrap a waist hold first, then lift; throws work best on a rival who is off balance.
rules: A wrestler who goes down on the sand, or is driven outside the circle, loses the round.
Each move beats two others and is beaten by two others; a good counter beats a good tap.
The waist wrap builds your grip; lifts need a grip and an unsteady rival.
A round also ends when one side leads by seven points, or when the clock runs out.
Use Breathe to recover stamina; tired moves are weak.
heritageNote: Laamb, known to the Serer as njom, is among the most popular sports of Senegal, with champions followed by whole neighbourhoods and large stadium days. This game shows only the sport: the hold, the throw and the push-out.
